lean.statement: theorem smallModel_sourceDerivedSections_naturality_compose {C : Type (v + 1)} [Category.{v} C] {T : GrothendieckTopology C} [HasSheafify T AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}] [HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (Sheaf T AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})] (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf T AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})) (L : CochainComplex (Sheaf T AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ℤ) [L.IsKInjective] (q : K.obj ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj L) (n : ℤ) {U V : C} (a : U ⟶ V) : let H := HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (.up ℤ) n let e₀ := fun W : C ↦ smallModel_sourcePlusHomIso ((strictLocalFreeSheaf T).obj W) K L q n let e₁ := fun W : C ↦ (smallModel_sourceClassDerivedHomIso ((strictLocalFreeSheaf T).obj W) L n).symm ≪≫ (leftHomologyData ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).obj ((strictLocalFreeSheaf T).obj W)) L n).homologyIso.symm ≪≫ H.mapIso (smallModel_sourceFreeSectionsComplexIso W L) AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Preadditive.leftComp (K⟦n⟧) ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map ((strictLocalFreeSheaf T).map a))) ≫ (e₀ U).hom ≫ (e₁ U).hom = (e₀ V).hom ≫ (e₁ V).hom ≫ H.map ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex ((sheafSections T AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).map a.op) (.up ℤ)).app L)
